name: prd-critic-stateless
description: Reviews a PRD you paste into the chat and returns its gaps: missing sections (problem, users, goals, non-goals, requirements, metrics, open questions), vague or untestable requirements, success metrics that are not measurable (no number, window or baseline), placeholders and unowned open questions, plus the questions a reviewer will ask, each tied to a quoted line of the PRD. A fixed rubric in code produces a 0-100 score with a band and a line-by-line breakdown, so the same PRD always gets the same score. A small CrewAI crew flags the requirements and drafts the questions, then a skeptical second pass drops the weak points. Follow-ups: only blockers, only metrics, list the questions, show score breakdown, as json. It keeps nothing between messages: follow-ups work on the PRD and review still in the recent conversation, and a long PRD from much earlier may need re-pasting. It reads only what you paste, never rewrites the PRD, never judges whether the idea is good, and sends nothing. Not for writing a PRD or general product advice.

skills.name: Review a PRD
skills.description: Gaps, reviewer questions and a 0-100 rubric score for a pasted PRD: missing sections, vague requirements, unmeasurable metrics, placeholders and unanswered questions, each tied to a quoted PRD line.
